title: Gluing of concrete open module direct-image units
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $U,V$ be open subsets with $U\cup V=X$, and let $M$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an open $A$, write $M_A=j_{A*}r_A M$, $\eta_A:M\to M_A$ for the transported restriction/direct-image unit, and $\rho_{A,W}:M_A\to M_W$ for the canonical nested-open restriction of [def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data]. Then the square with arrows $\eta_U$, $\eta_V$, $\rho_{U,U\cap V}$, and $\rho_{V,U\cap V}$ is a pullback in the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. No injectivity hypothesis is imposed on $M$.

proof.text: For each test open T, transport the three direct-image objects along Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv. Their sections are M(T intersection U), M(T intersection V), and M(T intersection U intersection V). Adjunction.ofNatIsoLeft writes each unit as the ordinary restriction unit followed by the pushforward of the comparison isomorphism. Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app identifies the ordinary unit with M.presheaf.map of the inclusion of image-preimage into T. The image-preimage is T intersection A. In the mate defining each overlap arrow, the inverse nested-restriction comparison, restricted counit, and forward comparison successively identify the source with the repeated restriction, cancel that repeated restriction, and identify the target with the smaller-open restriction. Naturality, functoriality of M.presheaf.map, and cancellation of the inverse/hom comparisons identify the overlap arrows with restriction of sections.

T intersection U and T intersection V cover T. Apply the sheaf axiom, equivalently Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.isLimitPullbackCone, to obtain a unique amalgamation for every pair of sections agreeing on T intersection U intersection V. Uniqueness forces these amalgamations to commute with every further test-open restriction and to preserve addition and scalar multiplication. They therefore define the pullback universal property in module presheaves. The fully faithful inclusion of module sheaves into module presheaves reflects this limit, proving the stated module-sheaf pullback. This applies to empty or repeated opens without modification.

theorem schemeOpenModuleImage_isPullback
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) :
    IsPullback ((schemeOpenModuleAdjunction X U).unit.app M)
      ((schemeOpenModuleAdjunction X V).unit.app M)
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U))).app M)
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V))).app M)
